h2: Pool Cleaning Uluuatu – One-Off Service & Green Pool Recovery
intro: Looking for pool cleaning Uluwatu villas can actually count on? We handle one-off deep cleans — skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash and full water-balance correction — with no subscription attached. Between salt-laden sea breeze and hard limestone water running through every tank and well on the Bukit, pools here take a beating that softer-water areas simply don't see.

sections.text: Cliff-top villas around Bingin and Ungasan sit directly in the path of salt-carrying sea wind. That spray settles on ladders, skimmer baskets, pump housings and metal fittings, accelerating corrosion well beyond normal wear. Add the hard limestone water flowing through tanks and deep wells across the Bukit, and scale builds up on tile lines and inside filter cartridges noticeably faster than in softer-water zones. A proper brush-down and backwash every few weeks keeps those deposits from becoming a structural problem.

A standard one-off job includes skimming leaves and debris, brushing all walls and the waterline, vacuuming the floor, backwashing or rinsing the filter, and checking chlorine plus pH balance. If the water has gone green or cloudy — common after heavy rain washes organic matter into the pool — we treat it as a recovery: algaecide, extended filtration run, re-test before leaving. Villa managers in Pecatu often book us the day before guest check-in so everything looks presentable.

Send a couple of photos showing the current state of the water, the tile line, and any visible equipment issues like scale or rust. Mention your villa's neighbourhood — Padang Padang, Balangan, Labuan Sait, wherever you sit on the Bukit — so I can factor in access and travel. From those images I'll give you a straightforward quote; pricing depends entirely on what the pool needs, whether that's a routine tidy-up or a full green-water turnaround.

sections.h3: Small Habits That Save Bigger Repairs
sections.text: Wiping down ladder rails and skimmer baskets with a dry cloth after a salty week slows corrosion by more than most owners expect. Keeping your tank float valve functional means you're not topping up with raw well water that throws off chemistry. Running the pump at least four hours daily, even when nobody is swimming, prevents algae from colonising long pipe runs. And if white scale starts creeping along the tile line, book a brush-and-balance visit before it bonds into the grout permanently.

faq.q: How often should I get my pool cleaned here?
faq.a: It really depends on usage, rainfall and how exposed the villa is to sea spray. Some owners tidy up monthly; others only call us before a guest arrival or when the water turns cloudy. Either way, a single visit covers everything from skimming to chemical balance.

faq.q: Can you recover a completely green pool?
faq.a: Yes — green-water recovery is one of our most common jobs. We treat with algaecide, run extended filtration, rebalance pH and chlorine, then confirm the water is clear before finishing. Send photos first so I can tell you what to expect.

faq.q: Do I need a retainer or subscription plan?
faq.a: No. Every job is quoted individually based on what the pool actually needs. You send photos on WhatsApp, I give you a price, and we sort out a time that suits your schedule.
